rationale: The fetch payload storage is not reset, while the reset and clear paths force the valid bit low; payload state is consumed only when valid is asserted.

mutation.description: Reduced the Ibex fetch FIFO to one valid-controlled payload slot.

provenance.adaptation: Retained the reset-valid and unreset-payload relationship while removing FIFO indexing and unrelated control.
